The refunds reported by Alpha Co are: `[{"order_id": 102, "amount_cents": 2289}, {"order_id": 105, "amount_cents": 33575}]`. The refunds requested in the batch are: `[{"order_id": 102, "amount_cents": 2289}, {"order_id": 103, "amount_cents": 12232}, {"order_id": 105, "amount_cents": 33575}]`.
